general_intro: Create and manage reusable speaker groups for your media players.
general_help: Open Speakers to choose speakers, adjust their volume rules, and save a group for reuse.
groups_intro: Create named speaker groups to reuse with your media players.
group_name_too_long: Group names can contain up to 80 characters.
group_duplicate_name: A group already uses that name.
group_select_members: Select at least one speaker for this group.
group_too_many_members: A group can contain up to 50 speakers.
groups_limit: You can save up to 50 groups.
group_members_help: Select the speakers in this group. Offline members are marked and can remain saved.
group_volume_help: The adjustment and maximum apply when a speaker volume is set for this group.
group_no_speakers: No speakers found. Turn them on and refresh the list.
groups_starting: The app is still starting. Try again in a moment.
group_delete_confirm: Delete "__name__"? Players and Flows that use it will need a new selection.
sonos_save_error: Could not save the Sonos mode.
sonos_load_error: Could not load the Sonos mode.
group_ip_help: Reserve fixed IP addresses for your Sonos speakers in your router. With Play Separately, Homey can reuse known addresses instead of scanning the network, so announcements can start faster.
group_auto_power_help: For announcements: a TV that is off is switched on first and switched off again afterwards.
auto_power_all: Turn on and off automatically for All speakers
auto_power_help: For announcements only. A TV that is off is switched on first and switched off again afterwards. Saved groups and Playback Devices have their own setting.
